reviewNotes: OXTR variation and intranasal oxytocin studies do not establish changes in OXTR transcription.
IL-6 protein and IL6 gene expression are separate measures; no blanket claim of reduced inflammation or symptoms.
Telomere and epigenetic-clock measures do not establish longer life.
Gene-expression engineering study PMID 25386727 uses an EEG-controlled optogenetic implant; native human transcription is not the measured mechanism.
DVA recommendations retain historical context; avoid a blanket current clinical recommendation.
Page 49 foundation bibliography reuses a veteran pilot citation under women and girls; the original attribution is visible, pending review.
Mindfulness population statistics retain their study dates and are not presented as current prevalence.
No current claim that TM has the largest evidence base. AHRQ 2007 supports historical prominence; 2025 bibliometrics show contemporary mindfulness predominance.
